description: End-to-end customer retention workflow for troubled telco subscribers, from churn risk detection through outreach, offer negotiation, approval, activation, and resolution.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the telco customer

account_id.description: Billing or service account identifier associated with the customer

case_id.description: Identifier for a retention case opened for a customer at risk of churn

outreach_id.description: Identifier for a specific retention outreach attempt (call, SMS, email, app notification)

offer_id.description: Identifier for a retention offer template or instance

offer_instance_id.description: Identifier for a customer-specific retention offer instance created during negotiation

approval_request_id.description: Identifier for a discretionary approval request (e.g., for high discount or exceptions)

order_id.description: Identifier for a service or billing order created as part of the retention resolution

functions.name: create_retention_case
functions.description: Create a new retention case for a customer identified as being at churn risk.

customer_id.description: Customer for whom the retention case is being created.

account_context.description: Context about the customer's account and services at the time of case creation.

account_id.description: Primary billing account associated with the retention case.

services.description: List of active services under the account.

billing_profile.description: High-level billing profile used to assess value and risk.

arpu_3m.description: Average revenue per user over last 3 months.

risk_assessment.description: Churn risk scores and drivers that triggered the retention flow.

overall_churn_score.description: Probability (0-1) or normalized score indicating churn likelihood.

drivers.description: Key drivers of churn as determined by analytics.

code.description: Internal driver code such as PRICE_SENSITIVITY, NETWORK_ISSUES.

model_version.description: Version of the churn model used.

channel_hint.description: Preferred outreach starting channel based on customer preferences if known.

initiated_by.description: Information about the system or agent that initiated the case.

id.description: Agent ID, system name, or campaign ID.

notes.description: Free-form notes about why this case is being created.

tags.description: Arbitrary labels used for segmentation and reporting.

functions.returns: Newly created retention case_id, initial status, and SLA timestamps.

functions.name: get_retention_case
functions.description: Retrieve full details of a retention case including history and current status.

include.description: Additional related entities to include in the response.

functions.returns: Retention case details including status, timeline, linked outreaches, offers, and actions based on requested includes.

functions.name: evaluate_churn_risk
functions.description: Re-evaluate a customer's churn risk and update an existing retention case if provided.

customer_id.description: Customer to evaluate for churn risk.

account_id.description: Account associated with the evaluation. If omitted, defaults to primary account.

observation_window.description: Time window and data scopes used for the risk evaluation.

case_id.description: If provided, the churn risk results will be attached to this case.

override_flags.description: Optional manual overrides and constraints for the risk model.

apply_business_rules_only.description: If true, only deterministic rules are applied, not ML scoring.

functions.returns: Updated churn risk score, band, drivers, and indication whether the linked case was updated.

functions.name: list_retention_cases
functions.description: List and filter retention cases for monitoring and workload management.
functions.returns: Paginated list of retention cases with selected metadata for each case.

functions.name: plan_retention_strategy
functions.description: Determine recommended retention strategies and candidate offers for a given retention case.

case_id.description: Retention case to plan a strategy for.

constraints.description: Business and operational constraints for the strategy.

max_discount_percentage.description: Maximum discount allowed without higher-level approval.

channels.description: Channels that can be used to execute the strategy.

time_horizon_days.description: For how many days the planned strategy should be valid.

customer_preferences.description: Explicit or inferred customer preferences to respect in the plan.

requested_by_agent_id.description: Agent requesting the plan, if any, to tailor guidance.

functions.returns: Recommended strategy object including prioritized offers, talking points, and any approval requirements.

functions.name: create_retention_outreach
functions.description: Create a retention outreach attempt (e.g., outbound call, SMS, email) associated with a case.

case_id.description: Retention case associated with this outreach.

channel.description: Channel used to contact the customer.

initiated_by_agent_id.description: Agent or bot ID initiating the outreach (for outbound) or handling (for inbound).

contact_endpoints.description: List of contact endpoints used or attempted in this outreach.

script_context.description: Context to generate or select a script for the outreach.

offer_instance_id.description: If a specific offer instance is being pitched during this outreach.

scheduled_time.description: If set in the future, the outreach is scheduled rather than immediate.

metadata.description: Additional free-form metadata for integrations and reporting.

functions.returns: Created outreach_id, scheduled or initiated status, and any script recommendations.

functions.name: update_outreach_result
functions.description: Update the outcome of a retention outreach attempt and capture customer responses.

outreach_id.description: Outreach whose result is being recorded.

interaction_summary.description: Detailed summary of the interaction if contact was made.

recording_url.description: Link to call recording if available.

linked_offer_instance_id.description: Offer instance that was discussed or agreed in this outreach.

technical_error.description: Details if the outreach failed due to technical issues.

functions.returns: Updated outreach record and derived next best action for the associated case.

functions.name: create_retention_offer_instance
functions.description: Instantiate a specific retention offer tailored to the customer's case, including pricing and terms.

case_id.description: Retention case for which this offer instance is being created.

base_offer_id.description: Template offer identifier or catalog entry.

pricing.description: Concrete pricing details proposed to the customer.

original_mrc.description: Original monthly recurring charge before discount.

discount_value.description: Value of the discount; interpreted according to discount_type.

discount_duration_months.description: Number of billing cycles the discount applies.

one_time_fees.description: List of one-time fees or credits applied as part of the deal.

contract_terms.description: Contractual terms associated with the retention offer.

eligibility_checks.description: Eligibility conditions that must be satisfied.

non_pricing_benefits.description: List of non-monetary benefits included in the offer.

created_by.description: Actor that created this specific offer instance.

requires_approval.description: Whether this offer exceeds standard thresholds and needs approval.

notes.description: Internal notes about this offer instance.

functions.returns: Created offer_instance_id, computed approval requirement, and summarized commercial impact.

functions.name: submit_approval_request
functions.description: Submit an approval request for a retention offer instance that exceeds standard limits.

case_id.description: Retention case associated with the approval.

approval_reason.description: Explanation of why an exception is needed.

requested_exceptions.description: List of policy exceptions being requested.

functions.returns: Created approval_request_id, initial status, and assigned approver or queue.

functions.name: process_approval_request
functions.description: Approve or reject a pending approval request for a retention offer instance.

decision_details.description: Details about the decision and any modifications.

approved_exceptions.description: Which exceptions were approved, if not fully approved.

modified_pricing.description: If the approver modifies the pricing, provide new values here.

functions.returns: Updated approval request status and any applied changes to the associated offer instance.

functions.name: activate_retention_offer
functions.description: Activate an accepted retention offer by creating necessary service or billing orders.

offer_instance_id.description: Offer instance that the customer has accepted.

case_id.description: Retention case to be resolved upon successful activation.

customer_consent.description: Evidence that the customer accepted the offer.

evidence_reference.description: Link or ID to the consent record (e.g., recording ID, document ID).

activation_options.description: Technical and operational parameters for activation.

activation_date.description: Date on which the new terms should become effective.

pro_rate_current_cycle.description: Whether to prorate charges for the current billing cycle.

apply_to_services.description: IDs of services to which the offer should be applied; if empty, infer from offer.

idempotency_key.description: Unique key to prevent duplicate activations in case of retries.

functions.returns: Created order_id(s), activation status, and updated case status if resolved.

functions.name: resolve_retention_case
functions.description: Mark a retention case as resolved (retained or lost) and perform final updates.

offer_instance_id.description: Offer instance that led to retention, if applicable.

order_ids.description: Orders linked to the resolution (e.g., plan change orders).

churn_reason.description: Standardized churn reason if the customer was lost.

request_survey.description: Whether to trigger a customer satisfaction or NPS survey.

functions.returns: Updated case status, timestamps, and any triggered post-resolution actions (e.g., surveys).

functions.name: retry_or_cancel_retention_flow
functions.description: Handle error recovery by retrying failed steps (e.g., outreach or activation) or cancelling the retention flow.

action.description: Recovery or termination action to perform.

target.description: Entity-level target for the recovery action.

outreach_id.description: Outreach to retry if action is retry_outreach.

order_id.description: Order to target for retry or rollback if action is activation-related.

offer_instance_id.description: Offer instance to rollback or reference.

reason.description: Explanation for the retry or cancellation.

retry_strategy.description: Configuration for how retries should be performed.

force_rollback.description: If true, attempt rollback even if consistency checks fail (use with caution).

functions.returns: Result of the recovery operation, including any new outreach_id/order_id created or rollback status.

functions.name: search_retention_cases
functions.description: Faceted search across telco retention cases with rich filters, time windows, pagination, and aggregations.

facets.description: Facets to compute alongside the result set.

projection.description: Fields to include in the result objects.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A page of telco retention case summaries with facet aggregations, pagination cursor, and optional scoring metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_retention_cases
functions.description: Create multiple telco retention cases in a single atomic or best-effort batch with idempotency and partial-commit options.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A bulk-job descriptor with per-item outcomes, created telco retention case ids, error reasons for failures, and an aggregate counts summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_retention_cases
functions.description: Apply patch-style updates to many telco retention cases with optimistic concurrency and partial-failure handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-item update outcomes (success/failure with reason), new versions for each telco retention case, and a summary of skipped and quarantined items.

functions.name: bulk_archive_retention_cases
functions.description: Archive or soft-delete many telco retention cases in one call with retention, audit reason, and webhook notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id outcome, new lifecycle state for each telco retention case, scheduled purge date if applicable, and a job id for tracking.

functions.name: export_retention_cases
functions.description: Export telco retention case datasets to an external sink in CSV, JSON, Parquet, or NDJSON with filters and signed-URL delivery.

split_by.description: Field to shard output by, e.g., tenant_id.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with job id, estimated row count, signed-URL(s) when applicable, and asynchronous completion event details.

functions.name: import_retention_cases
functions.description: Bulk-import telco retention case records from a file or staging table with schema mapping, validation, and quarantine handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An import job descriptor with counts of valid, invalid, and quarantined rows, sample error messages, and identifiers of created or updated telco retention cases.

functions.name: subscribe_to_retention_case_events
functions.description: Register a webhook or message-bus subscription to receive telco retention case lifecycle events with filtering and retry policy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created subscription record with id, secret rotation hint, active state, and an example test-event payload for the telco retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the immutable audit trail for a telco retention case, including who changed what, when, and from which channel.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A chronologically ordered list of audit entries for the telco retention case, each with actor, action, before/after diff, source, and optional evidence links.

functions.name: schedule_recurring_retention_case_job
functions.description: Create or update a recurring job for telco retention cases using cron, ISO interval, or calendar windows with backfill and concurrency controls.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated schedule descriptor with id, next run time, effective cron, and any backfill plan summary for the telco retention case action.

functions.name: simulate_retention_case_changes
functions.description: Preview the effect of a proposed change to a telco retention case without persisting, returning a diff and impact analysis.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A simulation report showing the resulting state of the telco retention case, a structured diff, policy-check verdicts, and a quantitative impact estimate (cost, latency, blast radius).

functions.name: request_retention_case_approval
functions.description: Create an approval workflow request for a telco retention case change, with multi-stage approvers, SLA, and evidence attachments.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: An approval-request descriptor with id, current stage, list of pending approvers, SLA deadlines, and links to the telco retention case under change.

functions.name: decide_retention_case_approval
functions.description: Record an approver decision (approve, reject, request changes) on a pending telco retention case approval request.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

expected_stage.description: Optimistic concurrency check on the approval stage.

functions.returns: The updated approval-request state including new stage, list of completed and pending approvers, and any condition list applied to the telco retention case.

functions.name: add_retention_case_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment, mention, or note to a telco retention case for collaboration and case-management context.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted comment record with id, threading info, visibility, mention/notification fan-out summary for the telco retention case.

functions.name: upload_retention_case_attachment
functions.description: Upload or link a binary attachment (evidence, log bundle, screenshot, contract) to a telco retention case with scanning and retention.

inline_data.description: Base64 payload when kind is inline_base64.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created attachment record with id, scan verdicts, signed download URL, checksum, and link to the telco retention case.

functions.name: create_retention_case_snapshot
functions.description: Capture an immutable point-in-time snapshot of a telco retention case (state, configuration, dependencies) for audit or rollback.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A snapshot record with id, size, checksum, encryption metadata, and a reference to the telco retention case version captured.

functions.name: restore_retention_case_from_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a telco retention case from a snapshot with selectable scope, validation pre-checks, and notification on completion.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A restore-operation descriptor with operation id, pre-restore snapshot id, validation results, conflict resolutions applied, and final state of the telco retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_metrics
functions.description: Compute and return KPI/metrics aggregates for telco retention cases over a time window with grouping, filters, and percentiles.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A metrics result with aggregate values, percentiles, optional period-over-period deltas, sparkline series per group, and the telco retention case domain context.

functions.name: get_retention_case_dashboard
functions.description: Return a pre-composed dashboard view for telco retention cases combining KPIs, alerts, top offenders, and time series.

personalize_for.description: User id to personalize widgets for.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A dashboard payload with KPI tiles, time-series data, top offenders, active alerts, and personalization metadata for the telco retention case context.

functions.name: create_retention_case_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule applied to telco retention cases with versioning, scope, and rollout strategy.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The created or updated policy record with id, version, rollout plan, scope, and an effective-evaluation summary against current telco retention cases.

functions.name: evaluate_retention_case_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a telco retention case in dry-run, returning per-rule verdicts and proposed actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-policy and per-rule verdicts with reasons, trace data, and a list of proposed (or applied, when apply_actions=true) actions against the telco retention case.

functions.name: get_retention_case_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the upstream and downstream dependency graph for a telco retention case including services, devices, tickets, and contracts.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A graph payload (nodes, edges, optional health and metrics) describing dependencies for the telco retention case, with depth and direction respected.

functions.name: link_retention_case_to_related
functions.description: Create or remove an association between a telco retention case and another business object (incident, ticket, contract, asset).

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The resulting association record (or removal confirmation) including direction, relation type, and a snapshot of the related-object summary for the telco retention case.

functions.name: assign_retention_case_owner
functions.description: Assign or reassign ownership/roles on a telco retention case with hand-off rules, watchers, and notification.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The updated assignment roster for the telco retention case with effective windows, hand-off receipts, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: tag_retention_cases
functions.description: Apply, remove, or replace tags and labels on one or more telco retention cases, with conflict resolution and audit.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Per-id tag-application outcomes with final tag sets and counts of added/removed/skipped operations for each telco retention case.

functions.name: compare_retention_case_versions
functions.description: Produce a structured diff between two versions (or snapshots) of a telco retention case with semantic equivalence handling.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A diff document describing added, removed, and changed fields between the two versions of the telco retention case, with optional side-by-side rendering.

functions.name: configure_retention_case_retry_policy
functions.description: Configure default retry, backoff, and circuit-breaker policy applied to telco retention case operations and their downstream actions.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The persisted retry/circuit-breaker policy with id, effective scope, and a summary of telco retention case operations that match the new policy.

functions.name: check_retention_case_health
functions.description: Run a synthetic health/probe sweep against a telco retention case and its critical dependencies and return aggregated health status.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: Aggregated health verdict for the telco retention case, per-probe results, dependency roll-up, and any alert notifications dispatched.

functions.name: clone_retention_case
functions.description: Clone a telco retention case into a new instance with selective fields, optional rename, and link-back metadata.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The cloned telco retention case record with id, lineage link to the source, and a summary of fields reset, copied, or skipped.

functions.name: generate_retention_case_report
functions.description: Generate a formatted telco retention case report (executive, operational, compliance) and deliver via email/object storage.

schedule_id.description: When generated by a recurring schedule.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: A report-generation receipt with report id, download URL or delivery confirmation, page/sheet count, and the telco retention case window covered.

functions.name: escalate_retention_case
functions.description: Escalate a telco retention case to a higher tier or owner group with reason, severity bump, and watcher fan-out.

request_context.description: User or system actor performing the action.

functions.returns: The escalation record with new owner/tier, severity, SLA, watchers, and a log of notifications sent for the telco retention case.
